{{Top|leg}}
A '''lobotomy''' was a neurosurgical procedure in which the connections to and from the pre-frontal cortex were cut from the [[Brain/Legends|brain]]. A lobotomy usually resulted in a serious loss of cognitive function.

[[Defeen]] tried to have [[Triclops]] lobotomized at the [[Imperial Reprogramming Institute]].<ref name="Mission from Mount Yoda">''[[Mission from Mount Yoda]]''</ref>

While imprisoned on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]], [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] remembered being threatened with being "lobotomized and then taken to one of the barracks' pleasure houses".<ref name="Children of the Jedi novel">[[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']]</ref>

An operation needed to lobotimize a [[Coruscani ogre]] and implant them with [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetics]] was less expensive when compared to purchasing a new [[Droid/Legends|droid]].<ref name="LO">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20030501ogre|series=Creature Feature|text=Lobotomized Ogre}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
During the production of [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']], it was decided that the talkative character of "Lando's aide" would be muted due to his cybernetic implants lobotomizing him.<ref name="BtM">''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''</ref> As a reference to this change, the character was named "[[Lobot/Legends|Lobot]]," a corruption of the word "lobotomy."<ref name="DB">{{DB|character|lobot|Lobot}}</ref>
